verdict.rationale: Drata documents a public APIv2 with explicit Custom Connections endpoints (List/Create Custom Connection, Create/update Device for Custom Connection) plus OAuth setup docs, enabling developers to push evidence/test results from systems not natively supported, and separately exposes Monitoring Tests and Controls endpoints to integrate custom test results. missing for 10: independent hands-on developer confirmation of building a custom connection end-to-end, and the OpenAPI spec/llms.txt itself returned 404 in probes, weakening self-serve discoverability.
